BV-BRC genome metadata fields, grouped by category
Source: `p3-all-genomes -f` (BV-BRC CLI) -- 150 fields
Categories from BV-BRC-Web (DataItemFormatter.js).
[inferred] = placed by JRaviLab, not BV-BRC.
*  = multi-valued        (ncbi) = cross-ref accession for pulling NCBI annotation
